scripts.build: nx run-many -t build -p contracts mcp-ext-skills dashboard cli server
scripts.check: pnpm check:repo && nx run-many -t lint -p repository dashboard && nx run-many -t typecheck -p contracts mcp-ext-skills dashboard cli server && nx run-many -t test -p repository dashboard && pnpm build && pnpm check:compose && pnpm check:pack
scripts.check:repo: python3 scripts/check_repo.py && python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v
scripts.check:compose: if docker compose version >/dev/null 2>&1; then REFLOW_DOMAIN=reflow.example.test ACME_EMAIL=ops@example.test REFLOW_FROM=noreply@example.test DATABASE_URL=postgresql://reflow:pw@postgres:5432/reflow BETTER_AUTH_SECRET=12345678901234567890123456789012 POSTGRES_PASSWORD=pw TEMPORAL_POSTGRES_PASSWORD=temporal-pw docker compose -f compose.yaml config --quiet && docker compose -f compose.dev.yaml config --quiet; else echo 'SKIP: Docker Compose plugin unavailable'; fi
scripts.typecheck: nx run-many -t typecheck -p contracts mcp-ext-skills dashboard cli server
